method.gpuProcessMode: Explicit macOS in-process GPU for both modes; default separate-GPU path remains unaccepted.
method.siteWorkload: Local search-box edits or Tab/Shift+Tab only; no form submissions, login or deliberate playback.
method.siteMeasurement: Direct producer harness; fresh context/browser, common HTTPS policy, 750 ms network settling plus fonts/two rAF; 2 warmups then 8 operations per mode. CERN has AB/BA order, two fresh rounds.
method.startupDifference: Native additionally performs the required short provenance trace and first supported complete native frame; ordinary ends at first JPEG80.
method.quality: Close all producers, replay archived genuine SKPs in an independent local CanvasKit browser, then compare to ordinary lossless PNG. Whole image + nine fixed 320x240 regions use the unchanged MAE<=3 and fraction(abs channel error>32)<=0.02. JPEG80 control is also checked against PNG in the final CERN run.
method.eligibility: Report ratios only after both producers, equal DOM text/input/scroll state, fresh native frames per action and both modes strict visual checks pass. No public-site pair passed.
performanceExclusions: Client decode/raster CPU and full viewer latency are excluded.
Native producer data is raw SKP/metadata; deduplicated resource counts are potential cache reuse, not measured HTTP/TLS wire bandwidth.
RSS is a sum with duplicated shared pages, not unique physical memory.
Main-page CDP response byte counts may miss out-of-process frames and TLS overhead.
Live remote content/network timing and small samples prevent general throughput/capacity claims.

fixApplied.kind: Main-document compositor widget binding in JS; no C++ or runtime binary changes.
fixApplied.identity: Exact current Page.getFrameTree frame id + URL/renderer commit + SetLayerTreeId; select newest unambiguous main widget. Ignore only trace-proven retired startup widgets; reject unknown additional widgets.
fixApplied.observedImprovement: CERN previously bound an old widget; after correction both native producer rounds and all four decode/ACK stages completed. Strict local visual checks still failed.
fixApplied.failureHandling: Prefer explicit frame-too-large over a generic later rAF timeout. No screenshot or DOM geometry is used to construct native frames.

fixedFixtureControl.scope: Existing independent-worker fixture harness, 12 measured click operations per mode plus a bounded burst. These are different workloads/IPC scope from the public-site direct harness; do not mix the latencies. JPEG80 output quality was not quantified by this fixture benchmark, so it is not an equal-quality performance claim.
